title: Great idea but poor in practise
body: Very unclear app. I subbed for premium and expected that I would receive tips/written guidance or something that they tease in free version. In reality it downloads a challenge and just tells u “do the love-yourself challenge for 20 mins a day, write what you did” no guidance or wtf that even means. The coaching I get isn’t even related to the challenge and is some philosophical nonsense on meaning on life. Like come on, if I pay almost 50 bucks for this, I don’t need a fancier to do list that I can get for free while feeding me some guru purpose of life lessons.

title: Incredible
body: An amazing app for those who are trying to create a better, healthier lifestyle full of new habits. This app concentrates on helping you to stick to your habits so they will have a great, positive impact on your daily life. I have been using this app for a couple of weeks and didn’t regret ever so slightly. Fabulous personally gave me aid in following a much brighter life path and I am forever grateful. Definitely recommend it
author: enfusiasme

title: Childish, weird and ghost like figures isn’t helping at all
body:
I was excited about this app when it asked the rights questions in the first steps... until day 2 when it turned into a children’s book with ghostlike floating figures and a woman’s voice that reminded me of children’s narrated books. 
I’m short it more of a storybook/ game than an actual aid. Very messy interface, too many things are packed in the interface and the sounds/music are annoying, especially when they come up during work outs. Had to remove as it caused me extreme stress to handle.
